notes: The closing clause is the verse's hard case: 'nevermore' is read as a rule 30/35 fusion of אֵין with עַד־עוֹלָם, the existential frame 'shalt … have any being' joining the same unit and the head on the negation per rule 50. The competing reading is named in that unit's note.
The suffix of אֵינְךָ takes the referential 'thou' under rule 50's explicit provision, the existential keeping the copula and negation.
